description: Refresh baseline job failures and effective rules, attach classifications and fixes, then execute repaired suites on representative candidates; verify no assertions or skip budgets were weakened to obtain green.

Collect and run the month-end regression under the actual CI DB command: real pg-hydrated Dates succeed on the tenant final day, an early invocation is rejected, and narrowly restoring the old normalization triggers the intended failure.

Run workspace DB suites from clean migrated databases; unavailable DB credentials fail clearly rather than skip; repeated execution and any configured parallel isolation do not leak or overwrite another suite data.

Use a disposable test workspace to add and move a test outside configured runners; discovery fails and identifies it, then passes when a real runner collects it; zero mandatory tests and an expired exclusion fail while a valid owned manual exclusion is explicit.

Exercise selection with temporary git revisions changing only root lockfile, harness, schema, selection script, service and EE package files; verify required suites are selected through the outer workflow and runner. Missing base, diff failure and graph failure cannot silently narrow execution; docs-only selection remains explainable.

Feed actual-format runner reports with success, intentional skip, todo, pending work, missing file, collection failure and truncated execution into reconciliation; verify required identities and completeness survive serialization and incomplete runs never become ready.

Evaluate aggregate decisions across success, failure, cancellation, unexpected skip, empty collection, absent/stale artifact, expired quarantine and explicit not-applicable selection; only a complete eligible mandatory set passes.

Read effective protections and exercise disposable candidate PRs with passing and deliberately failing required jobs; confirm actual mergeability respects stable check identities, preserves prior guards and records administrator/bot and freshness behavior.

Boot CE and EE production builds, log in with real credentials and assert dashboard/edition content; invalid credentials fail. Repeat with isolated users and tenants; force an assertion failure to verify sanitized first-attempt artifacts and that retry-only success remains flaky.

As an authorized non-admin, add usage with overlapping usage/bucket eligibility through the real UI action, reload and verify chosen contract, quantity/date and preview amount; another tenant cannot access the result and cannot cause cross-tenant mutation.

Submit a portal request, handle/assign/reply and reopen the associated ticket as MSP, then verify persisted response/status in a fresh portal session; a sibling client cannot read or update it and an ordinary technician cannot perform an admin-only action.

Log and submit ticket time, prove invoicing rejects unapproved time, approve and generate the invoice, and verify hours, rate, total and billed state; repeating generation does not bill that time twice.

Generate and finalize representative recurring and manual invoices from seeded business data, download the actual PDF and verify invoice identity and expected amounts; reload shows consistent status and repeating the request creates no unintended duplicate.

Send raw MIME through the built email service, intake, queue and DB for inline-blockquote and quoted-history cases; verify authored text, single ticket/thread, delivered reply headers and idempotent duplicate intake in the test mailbox.

Validate the tested manifest against component image digests and simulated deployed identities; replacing only the email-service digest or presenting a result from another manifest must reject promotion, while the exact tested component set passes.

Seed the previous supported schema with synthetic existing tenant/ticket/contract/usage data, run the real upgrade and verify retained records plus working ticket, Add Usage and invoice paths; preserve post-upgrade tenant isolation.

Against EE/Citus migrated/upgraded schema, create and query tenant-scoped business rows and generate a representative invoice; forbidden cross-tenant reads/writes are rejected. Confirm runtime behavior, not just distribution counts.

In dedicated test resources, exercise post-deploy and scheduled smoke; induce a controlled failure to verify notification and promotion handling, then rerun/cleanup twice to prove recovery and idempotency without customer recipients or live payments.

Write success, failure, cancelled, missing and retry-only rows to an isolated metrics workbook with representative historical data; verify additive schema, existing-reader compatibility, separate PR/main/nightly views, explicit non-ready states and visible measured/total file counts.

Run a compatible Stryker/Vitest pilot and prove selected tenant/eligibility/date mutations are killed by meaningful assertions; review surviving and equivalent mutants and attach the scoped baseline plus runtime cost.

Generate and replay month-end/DST calendar cases across selected tenant timezones and real pg date hydration; invalid dates are rejected and a deliberate normalization defect yields a shrunk, reproducible failing case.

Execute valid generated finalize/pay/credit/void/retry sequences against actual billing behavior using an independently simplified expected ledger; balances reconcile, disallowed transitions preserve state and duplicate retries cannot repeat financial effects; replay a seeded counterexample.

For the usage-context, month-end hydration and inbound-email exemplars, verify incident-to-journey-to-test mapping and actual CI execution; attach intended pre-fix failure and post-fix pass evidence, record mock/deployment limits and assign follow-up ownership.

Review the first completed readiness/escape report against actual runner output and effective gates, identify the oldest exclusion and highest-impact remaining escape category, and record owner/next action; verify documentation agrees with observed PR metrics and runner scope.

Run a real-login browser operation through production-built Alga to a wire-level provider emulator; verify server/worker routing, callback reachability, vendor and DB readback, isolated concurrent scenarios and reset. Capture a controlled failure with sanitized emulator/browser diagnostics and reject unexpected live-vendor traffic.

Complete invoice payment via simulated hosted Checkout and signed webhook, then reload and verify balance and vendor session; decline/cancellation leaves balance unpaid and replaying the same webhook cannot apply a second payment.

Connect QBO using the supported OAuth flow, choose company/mappings and export an invoice via UI; inspect the vendor invoice and Alga sync result, expire credentials and induce stale SyncToken/transient failure, then verify visible recovery with one invoice and correct company identity.

Exercise Microsoft mailbox reply and calendar meeting creation/update/deletion through actual app processes and Graph endpoints; verify provider state and reopened UI. Induce permission/token failures. Verify claimed auth coverage against the capability matrix and that production Teams override guards remain effective; prelinked fixtures do not count as SSO tests.

Connect Xero, select organization/mappings and export an invoice through UI; verify vendor and persisted sync state, induce connection expiry or rejected export and recover without duplicate invoices or organization/tenant crossover.

Exercise deterministic representative 429/5xx and supported duplicate/out-of-order callbacks through real provider clients; assert bounded retry/actionable failure and exactly-once effects. Verify required provider/configuration results feed selection and release decisions; advance vendor/app time only through documented independent mechanisms.

Validate covered emulator auth/error/callback shapes against independently sourced provider contracts or sanitized captures; deliberately introduce a response-contract mismatch and verify parity validation detects it. Unsupported routes fail explicitly and missing real-sandbox verification is recorded as a limitation.
